tmp:1706: bilbul ha-da'at — confusion of the mind, a mental state identified as mochin d'katnut (constricted consciousness), source of dinim and troubles
tmp:1707: shoresh ha-neginah she-bikdushah — the holy root of melody, located in the mochin/da'at of Malkhut of holiness, from which the cantor must draw song
tmp:1708: mochin ve-da'at shel Malkhut di-kedushah — the mental faculties and knowledge of the holy Malkhut, the prophetic source-consciousness from which holy melody is drawn
tmp:1709: mochin she-be-Malkhut di-kelipah — the mental faculties of the Malkhut of the husks, identified by the Arizal with the impure 'birds' of the kelipah
tmp:1710: Sitra Achra — the 'Other Side,' the demonic realm of impurity, here defined as the very aspect of machloket (dispute), rooted in dispute-within-holiness
tmp:1711: 'ein adam met va-chatzi...' — the rabbinic dictum 'no one dies with half his desires fulfilled,' read as referring to dispute via Targum's 'ba'alei chitzim' = disputants
tmp:1714: kol ha-chola'at — all illnesses/diseases, defined as bodily machloket: the four elements warring instead of resting in balanced peace within the body
tmp:1715: notzot — feathers (of the geese in Rabbah bar bar Chanah's tale), symbolizing strife and insults via the wordplay 'ki yinatzu anashim' (Deut. 25)
tmp:1716: machloket u-vizyonot — quarrel and humiliations as a paired concept, the strife-and-disgrace symbolized by feathers (notzot/yinatzu)
tmp:1718: machloket Shammai [ve-]Hillel — the archetypal dispute-for-the-sake-of-Heaven between the schools of Shammai and Hillel, whose initials spell MoSHeH
tmp:1719: machaneh Dan — the camp of the tribe of Dan, the rear-guard 'gatherer of all the camps,' emblem of Malkhut collecting the holy camps
tmp:1720: teiku — the Talmudic term for an unresolved halakhic question, read per Zohar (Ra'aya Mehemna) as 'tikkun' missing its final nun, i.e., lacking rectification
tmp:1721: mechusar tikkun — the state of 'lacking rectification,' what teiku signifies: tikkun deprived of its nun, an unrepaired deficiency
tmp:1725: machashavah techilah — the primal thought preceding action (potential/koach), symbolized by the initial Yud of the Tetragrammaton at the head of the Aleph
tmp:1730: Shaddai shel chol — the weekday manifestation of the divine name Shaddai, the contractions between labor and labor, identified with Metatron who rules the six weekdays
tmp:1731: 'mateh uzkha yishlach mi-Tziyon' — the verse 'the staff of your strength He will send from Zion' (Ps. 110:2), linked to sha'arei/se'arot (gates/hairs) of Zion in the first tikkun of the beard
tmp:1732: the principle that a kosher (worthy) person's melody is drawn from the two pure birds of holiness — fitness as prerequisite for untainted neginah
tmp:1733: mayin metikin — 'sweet waters,' the taste of sweetness in prayer, identified with pure waters (mayin dakhyan), holy seed, and guarding the brit
tmp:1735: MaL — the 'mal' component of ChashMaL, denoting milah/circumcision: cutting away the disgrace-foreskin after the silence (chash)
tmp:1737: shalhevet Yah — the 'flame of God' (Song 8:6), a descending holy fire that scorches the three impure kelipot so they cannot grasp holiness on erev Shabbat
tmp:1738: mayim chamin — the hot water of pre-Shabbat washing, embodiment of the shalhevet Yah flame that burns off the kelipot on erev Shabbat
tmp:1739: mayim karim — cold water that revives the soul, received via thunder generated by honoring an elder who forgot his learning
tmp:1740: meimei ha-chesed — the waters of lovingkindness, Avraham's bounty (the well of living water), his attribute of chesed
tmp:1741: 'meisharim eshpot' — 'I will judge with equity' (Ps. 75:3), taken as the aspect of anavah (humility) in judgment, per Chullin 89
tmp:1742: ha-noah veha-anachah — the groan and the sigh, which constitute a quasi-death of both body ('a sigh breaks a person's body') and soul
tmp:1743: mitah be-guf va-nefesh — death in body and soul, the twofold dying effected by the groan/sigh (Berakhot 58b; Ps. 104:29)
tmp:1745: ra ayin — the evil eye, equated with death of the heart; the cause of forgetfulness that destroys memory ('between your eyes')
tmp:1746: the principle that honor rises to its root in proportion to one's rectification of kavod — each honors God-fearers according to how far he has repaired the glory
tmp:1747: the ever-deepening recognition and apprehension of God — each new level of knowing Hashem that obligates teshuvah upon one's previous teshuvah
tmp:1748: subduing the 'breath of beauty' (hevel ha-yofi) — the shofar/beard tikkunei Atik action of humbling vain charm, narrow-above-wide-below (min ha-meitzar)
tmp:1749: machnia ha-medameh — the subduing of the imaginative faculty (dimyon), achieved by the 'hand' that sorts the good spirit from the evil spirit
tmp:1750: subduing idolatry that draws its power from the blemished altar-portions — accomplished through converts who complete the pegam ha-mizbe'ach
tmp:1751: machnia tola dikelipah — the holy worm ('I am a worm, not a man,' the olat tamid/chesed of Avraham) subduing the worm of the kelipah
tmp:1753: machni'in oto — subduing him/it (the impure ruach of Esav) via the white tallit and the Thirteen Attributes, the holy ruach-chayim
tmp:1754: machni'in ha-ruach se'arah — subduing the storm-wind, the spirit of opponents of true tzaddikim, through the four tzitzit drawing ruach from the four winds (Ezek. 37:9)
tmp:1756: 'tzaddik moshel' — 'the righteous one rules [over Me]' (II Sam. 23:3), the tzaddik's power over God, present in every Jew ('your people are all tzaddikim')
tmp:1757: melo pum — 'full mouth' (Aramaic), the letters of the melupum vowel: the tzaddik's mouth filled with Godliness, aspect of tzaddik-moshel
tmp:1758: hitlahavut — fiery enthusiasm/ardor of the heart, an angel-like burning ('angel of God in a flame of fire,' Ex. 3:2) that scorches the chitzonim
tmp:1759: malakhim — angels, the fiery beings to which heart-enthusiasm corresponds ('vayera elav malakh Hashem be-labat esh'), whose fire burns the external forces
tmp:1762: 've-Yosef hu ha-shallit' — the verse 'and Yosef, he was the ruler' (Gen. 42:6), Yosef/Yesod as the melupum-vocalized channel of abundance
